_doc: Centre of mass (object frame, m) and mass (kg) PhysX simulates for an asset, read in the physics-only twin with RigidPrim.get_com / get_mass (scripts/skills/physics_com.py). PhysX takes mass properties from the colliders, and RoboDojo's convex decompositions inflate thin parts to minThickness 20 mm, so this differs from the visual mesh's volume centroid (hammer 00005: 12.4 mm). An asset constant: the same assets and RoboDojo code give the same numbers on any machine.
